<a id="sid_clear"></a>
### [`sid_clear`](../../../../src/title/title_tune_4c30.asm#L6) `$4C30`

*routine*

Writes 0 to the SID registers $d401-$d419 ($d400 stays) and sets the note length $9c of the title tune to $bf.
